ValidationRule.description: Prevents users (except System Administrators) from creating or editing Opportunities when the associated Account is located in a sanctioned country. Ensures compliance with company policy and international restrictions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( Account.BillingCountry = "Afghanistan", Account.BillingCountry = "Cuba", Account.BillingCountry = "Iran, Islamic Republic of", Account.BillingCountry = "Korea, Democratic People's Republic of", Account.BillingCountry = "Russian Federation", Account.BillingCountry = "Belarus", Account.BillingCountry = "Syrian Arab Republic" ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunities cannot be created or edited for Accounts based in sanctioned countries. Please contact the Salesforce team if this is required for compliance reasons.
